metadata.title: Late 90s R&B Western Fusion Album Art

retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-driven layout featuring a central figure in western-inspired fashion against a warm sunset, anchored by ultra-wide futuristic typography and horizontal rule lines.
triggerTerms: extended futuristic typography with horizontal lines
denim and cow print fashion photography

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a woman wearing a cow-print cowboy hat and denim vest, set against a soft-focus sunset landscape. The composition is bisected by thin horizontal white lines that integrate with a wide, geometric sans-serif typeface.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sunset background contrasting with cool denim textures
Horizontal rule lines intersecting the subject and typography
Ultra-wide display type balanced against the verticality of the portrait
Cow-print patterns echoing the organic shapes of the clouds
coreInvariants: Thin horizontal white lines spanning the width of the frame
Warm golden-hour lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up, slightly angled, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the cow-print hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the hat down to the face, following the hair flow to the horizontal text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus landscape on the right side providing breathing room for the vertical text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (amber, gold, brown) in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo and blue denim in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white in the typography and cow-print patterns.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sunset glow with deep shadows in the denim and background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'E' and 'L' feature elongated horizontal bars that merge into the layout's rule lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-wide horizontal display type and small, vertically oriented secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide geometric feel of the era.
Provides the necessary square terminals and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a woman in a cow-print cowboy hat and denim vest at sunset, with a soft-focus field in the background and warm golden lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three thin white horizontal lines across the lower middle. Place ultra-extended white sans-serif text on the right, aligned with the lines. Add small vertical text above the main title.

verificationChecks: Are the horizontal lines perfectly straight and thin?
Is the main text significantly stretched horizontally?
Does the lighting feel like a warm sunset?
Is the cow-print texture visible on the hat?

adjustableVariables: Width of the horizontal rule lines
Amount of horizontal stretch on the typography
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or face
Do not replicate specific brand logos
Avoid exact 1:1 replication of the cow-print pattern

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible despite the stretch
Ensure the horizontal lines do not obscure the subject's eyes
Verify the color palette remains warm and cohesive
Confirm the vertical text is rotated correctly
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Western Fashion + Sunset Lighting + Extended Geometric Type + Horizontal Rule Lines
